name: evidence-derived-from-the-belief-it-would-support-is-refused
why: The acceptance-matrix row, and the reason M26 can flip agents on at all. An Observation written FROM revision 1 of this Belief is offered as support for revising it again: nothing has been learned, and the base has read its own handwriting back to itself as a second witness. Refused before the mutation lands, and refused regardless of risk — a LOW-risk auto-applying op is exactly where the loop would be invisible. The walk reads reducer state the mock has no counterpart for, so this fixture is rust_only; what the TS runner still holds is the artifact, which must declare self_ancestry possible for update_belief and route it to the ledger.
